description: The Geoelectric Field Calculator converts a geomagnetic time series into an estimated ground electric field. It supports one-dimensional conductivity or three-dimensional surface-impedance representations for geomagnetic-induction analysis. The resource is documented by NASA GSFC. The documented physical domain is Geospace, High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region, Global Ionosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Input magnetic records require quality control; numerical field calculations alone do not predict equipment failures. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
